title: Discontinuous Galerkin approximations of the Jordan-Moore-Gibson-Thompson equation in the vanishing relaxation limit
summary: The Jordan-Moore-Gibson-Thompson (JMGT) equation models nonlinear acoustic wave propagation in thermally relaxing media and in the vanishing relaxation limit approaches the damped Westervelt equation. We investigate discontinuous Galerkin spatial discretizations of the JMGT equation on simplicial meshes and analyze their behavior uniformly with respect to the relaxation parameter. Under practically relevant mixed Neumann and absorbing boundary conditions, we derive a priori error estimates independent of the relaxation parameter.
